title: Bump version and test tool dependencies
body:
## Summary

Bumps the package version to 1.1.0 and updates Playwright and Newman patch ranges.

## Changes

* package.json version and devDependencies

## How to test

Run npm install and npm test.

verixa_should_cover: Only dev dependencies change, no runtime code touched
Smoke run of Playwright and Newman is enough
Verixa should label it low risk
